title: Wiener · What breaks
description: Exit codes per process over time, and what needed a second try. A signature that keeps coming back is what §14's loop turns into a registry proposal.

panels.title: Failures by process and exit code

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SpanName AS process,
       SpanAttributes['process.exit.code'] AS "exit",
       count() AS failures,
       max(toUInt8OrZero(SpanAttributes['wiener.task.attempt'])) AS "worst attempt"
FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE ParentSpanId != '' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['cicd.pipeline.task.run.result'] IN ('failure', 'error')
GROUP BY process, "exit" ORDER BY failures DESC

defaults.noValue: No task has failed in this window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SpanName AS process,
       max(toUInt8OrZero(SpanAttributes['wiener.task.attempt'])) AS "attempts",
       count() AS spans
FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE ParentSpanId != '' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY process
HAVING max(toUInt8OrZero(SpanAttributes['wiener.task.attempt'])) > 1
ORDER BY "attempts" DESC

defaults.noValue: Nothing has needed a second try.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Timestamp AS time, SpanName AS process,
       SpanAttributes['process.exit.code'] AS "exit",
       SpanAttributes['error.type'] AS "why",
       SpanAttributes['cicd.pipeline.task.run.id'] AS "task.attempt"
FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE ParentSpanId != '' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['cicd.pipeline.task.run.result'] IN ('failure', 'error')
ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100

defaults.noValue: No task has failed in this window.
